title: Section projection on the normalized supported source
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, let $Y$ be any scheme, and put $P=\mathbf P^1_Y$ and $W=P\times_Y P$ with diagonal $\Delta:P\to W$ and second projection $p_2:W\to P$. Use the ordinary unbounded internal-module categories and canonical section comparisons of [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-pullback]. Fix a family $L_X\in\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ and a normalized coefficient diagram $d$ of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category]. Let $U=\Lambda_P[0]$, $V=R\Delta_*U$, $S=(\Delta_*\Lambda_P)[0]$, and $s:V\simeq S$ be supportedUnitIso of [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-composition]. Let $e:U\simeq\mathbf1_P$ be singleUnitIso and $j:d.R_2\simeq Rp_{2*}$ the canonical secondDiagramPushIso of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pull-comparison]. Define $a:\mathbf1_P\to Rp_{2*}S$ by $a=e^{-1};d.\mathrm{support}_2.\mathrm{hom};j_S$. For arbitrary $M\in D_\Lambda(P)$ let $\kappa_{2,M}:p_2^*M\otimes V\to R\Delta_*M$ be sectionTensorMap of [def-sfb-section-tensor-comparison] using the second canonical section comparison and $e$. Let $\pi_{p_2,M,S}$ be the fixed forward projectionMap and $\sigma_M:M\to Rp_{2*}R\Delta_*M$ the canonical pushSectionIso, both as fixed in [def-sfb-projective-diagonal-composition]. Then, writing semicolons in application order, $$\rho_M^{-1};(1_M\otimes a);\pi_{p_2,M,S};Rp_{2*}\bigl((1_{p_2^*M}\otimes s^{-1});\kappa_{2,M}\bigr)=\sigma_M.$$ Only the source normalization of $d$ is used; no class map, trace, integration equality, rational coefficient, or twist occurs.

source.place: Second identity, cancellation on the diagonal before integration.

proof.text: First apply the canonical section projection identity on the regular supported source, then replace its source arrow using the normalized supported-source identity for d.support₂ and secondDiagramPushIso.

theorem supported_section_projection
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ X) (d : Diagram Λ Y L)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ (ProjectiveLine Y))) :
    (ρ_ M).inv ≫
      (M ◁ ((singleUnitIso Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)).inv ≫ d.support₂.hom ≫
        (secondDiagramPushIso Λ Y L d).hom.app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
            (source Λ Y)))) ≫
      projectionMap Λ (secondProjection Y) M
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
          (source Λ Y)) ≫
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).map
        ((((moduleObjectDerivedPullback Λ (secondProjection Y)).obj M) ◁
          (supportedUnitIso Λ Y).inv) ≫
          sectionTensorMap Λ (diagonalImmersion Y) (secondProjection Y)
            (pullSectionIso Λ Y (secondProjection Y)
              (by unfold secondProjection; exact pullback.diagonal_snd _))
            (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) (singleUnitIso Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) M) =
      (pushSectionIso Λ Y).hom.app M
